verdict.rationale: PagerDuty documents a first-party Status Pages feature that shows real-time operational status and incident-resolution status, letting users publish updates from inside PagerDuty as the single source of truth. That covers the core of a hosted status page tied to incidents. However, the evidence never confirms the specific elements the story asks for. Missing for 10: evidence of public-facing hosting, custom domain support, subscriber notifications (email/SMS/webhook), explicit automatic linkage of page state to incident state, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
